abstract: 182 patients treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy for testicular cancer at Hannover University Medical School who were in complete remission (CR) for more than 1 year after therapy were randomly selected for the evaluation of late vascular toxicity. 90 patients with a mean age of 28 years (19-53) and a median follow-up of 57.9 months (15-159) participated in this examination. Patients were examined clinically and digital photoelectric pulse plethysmography (PP) and Doppler-flow of the digital arteries after cold exposure were performed. Thirty seven per cent of patients developed symptoms of Raynaud's phenomenon (RP) after chemotherapy, which were transient in 7%. PP proved to be highly diagnostic for RP with a sensitivity of 95% and a specificity of 100%. As significant risk factors for the development of RP, the cumulative dose of bleomycin (P < 0.05) and the use of bleomycin in combination with vinblastine (PVB-regimen) instead of etoposide (PEB-regimen) (P < 0.01) were found. A trend for an increased frequency of RP was observed in patients who received bleomycin as a bolus instead of continuous infusion. No significant correlation was seen with the cumulative or single doses of cisplatin, etoposide or vinblastine, serum magnesium levels during or after chemotherapy or a history of smoking. RP was not associated with the occurrence of neuro- or ototoxicity. All 7 patients with hypertensive blood pressure before chemotherapy developed RP. Furthermore, the median postchemotherapy diastolic blood pressure had increased by 8 mmHg compared to prechemotherapy values, leading to significant hypertension in 8 patients (> 20 mmHg increase). 2 patients developed major vascular events with myocardial infarctions at 4 years and 5 years after chemotherapy, respectively. No cerebral infarction was registered. In summary, RP is the main late vascular toxicity affecting one third of patients after curative chemotherapy for testicular cancer. However, the incidence of RP following PEB-therapy in contrast to PVB-therapy appears to be lower. Major vascular events seem to be rare. The prospective evaluation of late toxicity should be part of current chemotherapy treatment for testicular cancer, and long-term follow-up of surviving patients is recommended.
abstract_ja: ハノーバー大学医学部でシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けて精巣がんと診断され、治療後1年以上完全寛解(CR)を維持していた患者182例を無作為に抽出し、遅発性血管毒性の評価を行った。平均年齢28歳(19-53歳)、追跡期間中央値57.9か月(15-159か月)の90例が本検査に参加した。患者は臨床的評価を受け、寒冷暴露後に指動脈のデジタル光電式脈波計(PP)とドップラー血流測定を実施した。化学療法後に37%の患者がレイノー現象(RP)の症状を呈し、そのうち7%は一過性であった。PPはRPの診断に有用で、感度95%、特異度100%であった。RPの有意な危険因子として、ブレオマイシンの累積投与量(P<0.05)と、エトポシドを用いたPEB療法ではなくブレオマイシンをビンブラスチンと併用したPVB療法を用いたこと(P<0.01)が同定された。ブレオマイシンをボーラス投与された患者は持続投与の患者に比べてRPの頻度が高い傾向がみられた。RPの頻度は、シスプラチン、エトポシド、ビンブラスチンの累積量や単回投与量、化学療法中・後の血清マグネシウム値、喫煙歴との有意な相関は認められなかった。RPは神経毒性や聴覚毒性とは関連がなかった。化学療法前に高血圧を有していた7例全例がRPを発症した。化学療法後の拡張期血圧中央値は化学療法前より8 mmHg上昇し、8例で有意な高血圧(20 mmHg以上の上昇)を来した。2例は化学療法の4年後と5年後に心筋梗塞を発症した。脳梗塞は認められなかった。要約すると、RPは精巣がんの根治的化学療法後に約3分の1の患者に生じる主要な晩期血管毒性である。PEB療法後のRPの発生率はPVB療法と比べて低いようである。重大な血管イベントはまれと思われる。晩期毒性の前向き評価を化学療法の標準治療の一部とすべきであり、生存患者の長期フォローアップが推奨される。
